name: The Bone Library of Whales
description: Deep underwater, colossal whale ribcages form cathedral-like archives where knowledge is stored in pearls — each pearl a memory, glowing in the dark, tended by bioluminescent creatures.
prompt: Deep sea cathedral formed from colossal whale ribcages arching overhead, vertebrae columns support the structure, archives of glowing pearls embedded in bone shelves — each pearl contains a miniature scene/memory visible within, bioluminescent creatures tend the archives: anglerfish librarians, lantern shrimp scribes, vampire squid archivists, shafts of bioluminescent bacteria create light beams through dark water, immense scale, mysterious reverent atmosphere, 8k, underwater cinematography style
caption:
The ocean remembers what we forget. 🐋📚

Every song. Every journey. Every loss. Held in pearl and bone.
